fusions.name: Rustling Thicket
fusions.desc: The undergrowth around you lashes out, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to turn each against its allies for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Low-Branch Feint
fusions.desc: A switch of a low branch that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Leaf-Litter Den
fusions.desc: You sink into the leaf litter and are veiled for 6 seconds, moving 15% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks when you attack.

fusions.name: Moonlit Cover
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
